card.name: Teaspoon and tablespoon measures
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after teaspoon or tablespoon, or the word teaspoon itself before "ful", after an amount. Seen in recipes, cleaning steps and dosing tables.

modes.label: "of" after spoon measure
modes.description: The word "of" follows teaspoon or tablespoon and leads into the substance measured.
modes.example: Use about a ½ teaspoon<< of>> soap?

modes.label: teaspoon before -ful
modes.description: The word teaspoon is followed by "ful" after a number or fraction in dose amounts.

card.writes: It seems to help predict the substance being measured, such as soap, bleach or applesauce, though the listed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on "teaspoon" or "tablespoon" and the "of" that follows, just before the thing being measured is named.
